subject.title: fix: prevent dev watch rebuild loops after live git pulls

question: Should this member-authored, maintainer-labeled PR be merged after current-head watch-loop validation confirms the generated-output metadata accurately covers all bundled extension build hooks?
rationale: The patch changes the development runtime’s restart classifier and is protected by the repository’s `maintainer` label; the remaining choice is merge acceptance rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Validate then merge
options.body: Confirm the live source-tree watch behavior at the current head and merge if generated outputs cause no self-triggered restart while normal source edits still restart.

options.title: Request narrower evidence
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript that shows a live pull or equivalent metadata update causes one rebuild and restart, then re-review the exact head.

recommendation.title: Validate then merge
recommendation.body: Confirm the live source-tree watch behavior at the current head and merge if generated outputs cause no self-triggered restart while normal source edits still restart.
